column3: Close to the Hebrew; תּוֹרָתִי (“my teaching, torah”) is rendered “my law.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” is rendered “mercy and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “good insight” is rendered “high esteem.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְהוּא יְיַשֵּׁר (“make straight”) is rendered “shall direct.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְשָׁרֶּךָ (“to your navel”) is rendered “to your flesh,” and “refreshment” “strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִפְּנִינִים (“than corals/pearls”) is rendered “than rubies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “well-being” is rendered “peace.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from its owners” is rendered “from those to whom it is due.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and he dwells securely with you” is rendered “For he dwells by you for safety’s sake.”
